name: simplified-ai
description: AI social media management, on-brand content creation, scheduling, analytics, and marketing workflows with Simplified.

interface.longDescription: Plan, create, and schedule social media posts across 13 platforms, with on-brand images and video, from one conversation. Simplified for AI helps marketers, agencies, and small businesses plan content calendars and campaigns, draft and schedule posts, and turn analytics into next steps. It also manages brand kits, marketing projects, and client review bundles, all through the hosted Simplified connector. Requires a Simplified account. Posts are drafted for your review and only scheduled or published after you confirm, and image and video generation uses your workspace credits.
defaultPrompt: Plan a month of content for my connected channels.
Turn this launch brief into a cross-platform campaign.
Review social performance and recommend what to do next.
